Service monitor of the 6-r1 stand.
files.client.py:
import requests

BASE_URL = "https://payments.test"


def load_day(day):
    items, cursor = [], None
    while True:
        response = requests.get(BASE_URL + "/payments", params={"day": day, "cursor": cursor}, timeout=10)
        response.raise_for_status()
        page = response.json()
        items.extend(page["items"])
        cursor = page["next_cursor"]
        if cursor is None:
            return items
